questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg valgte Italien, da jeg ville lære sproget. Og da Milano var min eneste mulighed i Italien, faldt valget herpå.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Det har været en oplevelse for livet, og har fået nogle fantastiske venskaber som jeg er så heldig at kunne tage med hjem til Danmark.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer:
Man skal være indstillet på at søge information og vejledning selv hvis nødvendigt. 
Gennem UNIMI's hjemmeside kan man finde ret meget af den fornødne information, når man ankommer.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik ikke hjælp.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: Man skulle selv søge hjælpen, og hvis man gjorde, var den også at hente.

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Hvis du er i god tid, er det relativt overskueligt. Den månedlige husleje er generelt høj i Milano.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: Hvis du ikke er ude i god tid, kan du risikere meget høje huslejer og generelt dårligere forhold.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Student Housing lå alt for langt ude af byen, så jeg overvejede slet ikke denne mulighed.

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Det var relativt nemt, når man lige havde sat sig ind i systemet. Det har krævet mange timer at finde de rette kurser og sikre, at de også blev udbudt under ens ophold. Dette var min største udfordring.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer:
Man danner sig et overblik over de kurser, der er tilgængelige under ens ophold. Her bør man være opmærksom på, at de oftest opererer med trimesters på kandidaten på UNIMI. 
Dernæst registrerer man dem bare via et link, som man får tilsendt inden ankomst, og sender det derefter til godkendelse hos både KU og UNIMI.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: The International Mobility Office og mere specifikt vores kontaktperson Massimo Costa blev min primære hjælp til at udrede eventuelle udfordringer med at få fagene til at gå op.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik de fag, jeg gerne ville have.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Forbliv rolig. Så snart man lander i Milano er de meget fleksible omkring hele forløbet, og man har tre uger til at starte med, hvor man kan afprøve de kurser, man har sat sig for.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg havde gode professorer og en generel god oplevelse med universitet. Dog kan jeg forstå på andre, at dette bestemt ikke var alles oplevelse.

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Niveauet er generelt en del lavere end på KU.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Jeg havde udelukkende forelæsninger, og heri indgik så også gruppearbejde, fremlæggelse, diskussioner etc.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Conflict Management & Negotiation, Research Methods in Social and Political Sciences, Work Psychology (foregik på italiensk, altså Psicologia del Lavoro)

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Conflict Management & Negotiation var et rigtig godt fag med en meget dygtig og sød professor. Hvis man taler italiensk, eller er frisk på en udfordring vil jeg også anbefale Psicologia del Lavoro (Arbejdspsykologi).

questions.question: Insurance DKK *
Housing DKK per month *
Books DKK per month *
Local transportation DKK per month *
Food DKK per month *
Personal spending DKK per month *
Communication (phone, internet, etc.) DKK per month *
Other fees DKK per month *
What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Ingen lige umiddelbart.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: At handle er ligeså dyrt som i Danmark, hvorimod det at gå ud at spise/drikke er væsentligt billigere end i DK.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg afsøgte ikke disse muligheder.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Jeg deltog ikke i studenteraktiviteter, så dette kan jeg ikke udtale mig meget om.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Ingen.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Tag på weekendture til de omkringliggende byer. Milano er meget godt og centralt placeret, hvorfor det er en perfekt by at tage på mange forskellige ture fra.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Relativt nemt.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer:
Jeg fik en language exchange buddy, som var fra Milano, og som jeg mødtes med en gang om ugen og snakkede italiensk med. 
Derudover var der ikke andre udvekslingsstuderende på to af mine fag, hvorfor jeg også omgik mange lokaler her.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Der er en tydelig sprogbarriere, da de færreste snakker godt engelsk. Dette gælder alle aldersgrupper, og det kan være en udfordring i visse henseende.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Madkulturen og deres fleksible og afslappede tilgang til livet.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Lad vær at stresse for meget over fag etc., førend du ankommer. Så snart du er ankommet viser det sig at være meget nemmere at få fag, end man først havde troet.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Vær ude i god tid ift. at finde housing. Det kan hurtigt blive en meget dyr fornøjelse, og du kan ende med at bo et stykke uden for byen og dermed bruge meget tid på transport etc.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: At lære sproget og det at omgås og trives i en ny kultur, der på mange måder er meget anderledes end vores. Det bedste har dog været alle de gode venskaber, jeg har fået og kunne tage med hjem.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Sprogbarrieren og det at begå sig på et nyt sprog. Med dette mener jeg både generelt, men også ift. at tage et fag på italiensk. Dette var en stor udfordring men meget frugtbar.

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: Nyd det <3

questions.question: Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
